meta.title: THE CURSED CASTLE
meta.subtitle: Thornveil Castle
meta.description: A 360-degree escape adventure. Two apprentices, seven rooms, six seals and one final riddle.

ui.emptyNotes: No notes yet. Tap clues to save them here.

ui.beam: Tap a mirror to turn it.
ui.wordStrip: Tap letters to fill the strip.

ui.winText: You are now a Keeper of the Seven Seals.
ui.loseText: The curse closes over Thornveil. Try again.

about.title: Your mission
text: Thornveil Castle was once a school of magic. It forgot why magic exists, and that forgetting is the curse.
You are Kael and Nira. The door has sealed behind you. Win a Seal in each of the rooms, then wake the Guardian and answer its one question.
You have seven minutes. Look around, tap the glowing things, read the clues and solve each puzzle.

tutorial.text: This is your time. You have seven minutes. The clock stops while Kael and Nira talk. Merit is your score.
Pause stops the clock. It also has sound settings.
Stuck? Nira can give two hints in each room. Each hint costs 25 Merit.
Nira's notebook keeps your items, notes and progress.
Win a seal in every room. Seven seals open the way out.

idle.speaker: nira
idle.text: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

intro_a.speaker: narrator
intro_a.text: Past the last village, at the edge of every map, stands a castle no one remembers.

intro_b.speaker: kael
intro_b.text: Thornveil. The masters say it's forbidden.

intro_b.speaker: nira
intro_b.text: Which is why my notebook has a whole page about it.

intro_c.speaker: narrator
intro_c.text: They step inside, and the door slams shut behind them.

r1_enter.speaker: kael
r1_enter.text: The door just vanished behind us!

r1_enter.speaker: nira
r1_enter.text: Sealed, not broken. Someone wanted this place to keep its secrets.

r1_enter.speaker: kael
r1_enter.text: Then let's find the first one.

r1_inscription.speaker: nira
r1_inscription.text: A riddle. Teeth that can't bite, opens doors with no hands.

r1_riddle_wrong1.speaker: kael
r1_riddle_wrong1.text: A comb? It doesn't open much.

r1_riddle_wrong1.speaker: nira
r1_riddle_wrong1.text: Teeth, yes. But which one opens doors?

r1_riddle_wrong2.speaker: nira
r1_riddle_wrong2.text: Think about what you hold to open a door.

r1_riddle_right.speaker: nira
r1_riddle_right.text: A key! It must be hidden somewhere in this room.

r1_riddle_right.speaker: kael
r1_riddle_right.text: Where do you hide a key in a place where time stopped?

r1_riddle_right.speaker: nira
r1_riddle_right.text: That clock. It stopped at midnight. Let's take a closer look.

r1_clock.speaker: kael
r1_clock.text: Stopped at midnight. Everything here stopped at once.

r1_clock.speaker: nira
r1_clock.text: Wait. There's paper behind the cracked glass.

r1_paper.speaker: nira
r1_paper.text: In a place like this, that's never a coincidence.

r1_statues_wrong.speaker: nira
r1_statues_wrong.text: Read the paper again. Left to right, as written.

r1_sigil.speaker: nira
r1_sigil.text: The Moon Sigil. Selvai. One of seven, I think.

r2_enter.speaker: kael
r2_enter.text: Four portraits. They're all watching us.

r2_plate.speaker: nira
r2_plate.text: Each frame has a number, but I can't read them from here.

r2_plate.speaker: nira
r2_plate.text: We should look closely. First we need to know who's who.

r2_first_keeper.speaker: kael
r2_first_keeper.text: A talking portrait. Rude, but talking.

r2_knight.speaker: knight
r2_knight.text: I am younger than everyone in this hall.

r2_knight.speaker: knight
r2_knight.text: I was brave, but I faced the dark alone.

r2_scholar.speaker: scholar
r2_scholar.text: The King is older than I am.

r2_scholar.speaker: scholar
r2_scholar.text: I chased power and forgot my friends.

r2_scholar.speaker: nira
r2_scholar.text: He chased power and forgot his friends. I'm writing that down.

r2_king.speaker: king
r2_king.text: The Lady is older than I am.

r2_king.speaker: king
r2_king.text: I hoarded gold until my halls grew cold.

r2_lady.speaker: lady
r2_lady.text: I am the oldest of the four.

r2_lady.speaker: lady
r2_lady.text: I feared losing everything, so I locked every door.

r2_zoom.speaker: kael
r2_zoom.text: I can't read that from here.

r2_zoom.speaker: nira
r2_zoom.text: Move closer. There's a tiny number on each nameplate.

r2_discuss.speaker: nira
r2_discuss.text: Let's line them up. Who's the youngest?

r2_discuss.speaker: kael
r2_discuss.text: The Knight. He said so himself.

r2_discuss.speaker: nira
r2_discuss.text: Good. Work out the rest, then read each Keeper's number in that order.

r2_wrong1.speaker: kael
r2_wrong1.text: Nothing. Did we mix up who's older, or misread a number?

r2_wrong1.speaker: nira
r2_wrong1.text: Check what each Keeper said, then the numbers in my notes.

r2_wrong2.speaker: nira
r2_wrong2.text: Youngest first. What number is on that Keeper's frame?

r2_wrong3.speaker: nira
r2_wrong3.text: Knight, Scholar, King, Lady. Read each frame's number in that order.

r2_right.speaker: kael
r2_right.text: One, five, eight, three. It's open!

r2_right.speaker: nira
r2_right.text: The Time Sigil. Chronith. Their words lined up like a clock.

r3_enter.speaker: kael
r3_enter.text: The books are flying. Can we borrow one?

r3_note.speaker: nira
r3_note.text: The beginning of every line holds the truth. There must be lines to read.

r3_book4.speaker: kael
r3_book4.text: Found one drifting up here near the ceiling!

r3_book4.speaker: nira
r3_book4.text: Of course it was the one we'd never look for.

r3_discuss.speaker: kael
r3_discuss.text: Four books, four sentences. Now what?

r3_discuss.speaker: nira
r3_discuss.text: The note says the beginning. What's at the beginning of a sentence?

r3_wrong1.speaker: nira
r3_wrong1.text: Take the very first letter of each sentence.

r3_wrong2.speaker: nira
r3_wrong2.text: Keep them in book order, one to four.

r3_wrong3.speaker: nira
r3_wrong3.text: M, then O, O, N. Does it remind you of anything?

r3_wrong_symbol.speaker: nira
r3_wrong_symbol.text: The word and the symbol need to match.

r3_right.speaker: nira
r3_right.text: The moon is everywhere in this castle. It must matter. Sapiel.

r4_enter.speaker: kael
r4_enter.text: Finally, something that bubbles! Let's mix everything and see.

r4_enter.speaker: nira
r4_enter.text: Kael, no. Potions go by instructions, not by feel.

r4_cabinet.speaker: nira
r4_cabinet.text: The Elixir of Memory. Remembering again. This castle really can't stop.

r4_recipe.speaker: nira
r4_recipe.text: First, awaken the water. Then the breath of the forest.

r4_recipe.speaker: kael
r4_recipe.text: Poetry that is also homework. My two worst things.

r4_bottles.speaker: kael
r4_bottles.text: This red one looks the coolest.

r4_wrong1.speaker: nira
r4_wrong1.text: Order matters. Each step changes the next.

r4_wrong2.speaker: nira
r4_wrong2.text: Read the recipe one line at a time. What is the first line asking for?

r4_wrong3.speaker: nira
r4_wrong3.text: Water first. Then think about what 'the breath of the forest' could be.

r4_dragon.speaker: nira
r4_dragon.text: It isn't in the recipe. If it isn't written, it stays in the bottle.

r4_right.speaker: kael
r4_right.text: It's turning gold. It's turning silver!

r4_right.speaker: nira
r4_right.text: That's the Elixir of Memory. Now, the cabinet. Aequa.

r5_enter.speaker: kael
r5_enter.text: The whole sky is inside this tower!

r5_enter.speaker: nira
r5_enter.text: Not the sky. A map of it. Look, four constellations.

r5_plate.speaker: nira
r5_plate.text: An ancient crown, made of stars. And we begin with the brightest.

r5_telescope.speaker: nira
r5_telescope.text: The Silver Star. That's where we start.

r5_map.speaker: nira
r5_map.text: A path of light joining the stars. It does look like a crown.

r5_map.speaker: kael
r5_map.text: And every star has a number.

r5_wrong1.speaker: nira
r5_wrong1.text: Follow the path and read the numbers in order.

r5_wrong2.speaker: nira
r5_wrong2.text: Start at the brightest star. What is its number?

r5_wrong3.speaker: nira
r5_wrong3.text: Silver, North, Crown, Falling. Read their numbers in that order.

r5_right.speaker: kael
r5_right.text: One, three, four, two. It's open!

r5_right.speaker: nira
r5_right.text: The Star Sigil. The stars point the way. Astrel.

r6_enter.speaker: kael
r6_enter.text: I can't see my own boots.

r6_enter.speaker: nira
r6_enter.text: Then we follow the light. That beam, there.

r6_gate.speaker: nira
r6_gate.text: One light, three mirrors, one destination.

r6_gate.speaker: kael
r6_gate.text: The destination has to be that crystal.

r6_runes.speaker: nira
r6_runes.text: Mirrors bend light a quarter turn. Edge-on, they let it through.

r6_panel.speaker: kael
r6_panel.text: Okay. Twist, twist, twist and hope?

r6_panel.speaker: nira
r6_panel.text: Twist and watch where the beam goes.

r6_stuck1.speaker: nira
r6_stuck1.text: Where does the beam stop? That's the mirror to change.

r6_stuck2.speaker: nira
r6_stuck2.text: Start with the mirror nearest the light.

r6_right.speaker: kael
r6_right.text: It's glowing! The gate is moving!

r6_right.speaker: nira
r6_right.text: The Light Sigil. Light defeats the shadow. Illura.

r7_enter.speaker: nira
r7_enter.text: Six slots. Six seals. We've earned every one.

r7_guardian.speaker: guardian
r7_guardian.text: Only those who carry six seals may wake me.

r7_before.speaker: nira
r7_before.text: Each Keeper told us what went wrong. Check your notes before you answer.

r7_wrong1.speaker: kael
r7_wrong1.text: The statue's eyes flickered. That wasn't it.

r7_wrong1.speaker: nira
r7_wrong1.text: Think about what the Keepers lost.

r7_wrong2.speaker: nira
r7_wrong2.text: Wealth, power and fear are already ruled out.

r7_guardian_a.speaker: guardian
r7_guardian_a.text: Long ago the Keepers forgot why Thornveil held magic.

r7_guardian_a.speaker: guardian
r7_guardian_a.text: Gold, power and fear filled their hearts, and the magic had no purpose left.

r7_guardian_a.speaker: guardian
r7_guardian_a.text: You came in anyway, together, and not too afraid to go on.

r7_guardian_a.speaker: guardian
r7_guardian_a.text: Magic is not for owning or hiding. It is for the brave to share with friends.

r7_guardian_b.speaker: guardian
r7_guardian_b.text: Take the Crown, Keepers. The castle remembers.

r7_final_a.speaker: kael
r7_final_a.text: Seven rooms. Seven seals. And a castle that forgot why it was magic.

r7_final_a.speaker: nira
r7_final_a.text: It didn't need gold or power. It needed someone to be brave first.

r7_final_a.speaker: kael
r7_final_a.text: Even you, after reading the instructions three times?

r7_final_b.speaker: nira
r7_final_b.text: Especially then. Courage isn't not being scared. It's opening the door anyway.

r7_final_b.speaker: kael
r7_final_b.text: That was the best thing you've ever said. Don't tell anyone I said so.

r7_final_b.speaker: nira
r7_final_b.text: I'll write it in my notebook.

h_r2_0.speaker: nira
h_r2_0.text: Look at the brass plate on the far door first.

h_r3_0.speaker: nira
h_r3_0.text: Start with the note on the reading desk.

h_r3_2b.speaker: nira
h_r3_2b.text: Find the rest of the books first. Look up as well as around.

h_r4_0.speaker: nira
h_r4_0.text: Look at the locked cabinet first.

h_r4_1c.speaker: nira
h_r4_1c.text: Check the bottles on the long table.

h_r4_1b.speaker: nira
h_r4_1b.text: Read the recipe on the lectern.

h_r5_0.speaker: nira
h_r5_0.text: Read the plate on the metal box.

h_r5_0c.speaker: nira
h_r5_0c.text: Study the star map on the table.

h_r6_0g.speaker: nira
h_r6_0g.text: Read the carving on the gate.

h_r6_0r.speaker: nira
h_r6_0r.text: Touch the glowing runes on the floor.

h_r6_2r.speaker: nira
h_r6_2r.text: The runes explain how mirrors work. Read all three.

h_r1_1.speaker: nira
h_r1_1.text: Look at the glowing spot. We need to find out what that is.

h_r1_2.speaker: nira
h_r1_2.text: Read the inscription again, then pick the answer that opens doors.

h_r1_2b.speaker: nira
h_r1_2b.text: Read the paper again, left to right.

h_r1_2c.speaker: nira
h_r1_2c.text: Something on the table changed. Take a good look.

h_r1_2d.speaker: nira
h_r1_2d.text: Use the key on the great door.

h_r2_1.speaker: nira
h_r2_1.text: Who is the youngest? Look at the Knight.

h_r2_2.speaker: nira
h_r2_2.text: Youngest to oldest: Knight, Scholar, King, Lady. Zoom in on every frame to read its number.

h_r3_1.speaker: nira
h_r3_1.text: There are four books to find. Look high and low.

h_r3_2.speaker: nira
h_r3_2.text: Look at the first letter of each sentence.

h_r4_1.speaker: nira
h_r4_1.text: The recipe tells us what to do. Read it.

h_r4_2.speaker: nira
h_r4_2.text: The first line asks for water. Take the clear blue flask first.

h_r5_1.speaker: nira
h_r5_1.text: Look at the glowing spot. The next clue is there.

h_r5_2.speaker: nira
h_r5_2.text: The path goes Silver, North, Crown, Falling.

h_r6_2.speaker: nira
h_r6_2.text: Start with the mirror nearest the light.

h_r7_1.speaker: nira
h_r7_1.text: Open your notes and read the Keepers' regrets.

h_r7_2.speaker: nira
h_r7_2.text: Three of the four answers are already ruled out.

r1_inscription.title: The inscription
r1_inscription.text: I have teeth, but I cannot bite. I open doors, but I have no hands. What am I?

r1_clock.title: The clock
r1_clock.text: Stopped at midnight. Something is folded behind the glass.

r2_plate.title: The door plate
r2_plate.text: The Keepers hang here in order of age. Each frame carries a number, too small to read from far away. Look closely at every frame. Read the numbers from the youngest Keeper to the oldest.

r3_note.title: The note on the desk
r3_note.text: The beginning of every line holds the truth. Read carefully, and the hidden word shall reveal itself.

r3_book1.title: Book I of IV
r3_book1.text: Many secrets sleep beneath the stars.

r3_book2.title: Book II of IV
r3_book2.text: Only the patient can find the truth.

r3_book3.title: Book III of IV
r3_book3.text: Open your mind to the ancient light.

r4_cabinet.title: The locked cabinet
r4_cabinet.text: This lock has forgotten how to open. Only the Elixir of Memory will wake it.

r4_recipe.title: The recipe
r4_recipe.text: First, awaken the water. Then add the breath of the forest. Next, invite the light of the sun. Finally, seal the mixture with the dust of the moon.

r5_plate.title: The clue plate
r5_plate.text: Find the stars that form the ancient crown. Begin with the brightest. Follow the path until the final star completes the shape.

r5_telescope.title: The telescope
r5_telescope.text: The Silver Star is the brightest.

r5_map.title: The star map
r5_map.text: A dotted path joins the stars of the crown: the Silver Star, the North Star, the Crown Star and the Falling Star.

r6_gate.title: The carved gate
r6_gate.text: One light. Three mirrors. One destination. Turn what is hidden toward what is seen. Only when the light touches the heart shall the gate awaken.

r6_rune1.title: Rune of the Turn
r6_rune1.text: A mirror bends light a quarter turn.

r6_rune2.title: Rune of the Edge
r6_rune2.text: A mirror seen edge-on lets light pass.

r6_rune3.title: Rune of the Heart
r6_rune3.text: The crystal wakes when light touches it.

r7_guardian.title: The Guardian
r7_guardian.text: Only those who carry six seals may wake me.

k_knight.title: The Knight
k_knight.text: I was brave, but I faced the dark alone.

k_scholar.title: The Scholar
k_scholar.text: I chased power and forgot my friends.

k_king.title: The King
k_king.text: I hoarded gold until my halls grew cold.

k_lady.title: The Lady
k_lady.text: I feared losing everything, so I locked every door.

paper.name: Folded paper
paper.text: Three symbols in a row: Moon, Sun, Star.
paper.purpose: Shows the order to touch the statues.

iron_key.name: Iron key
iron_key.text: An iron key. It looks like it fits the great door.

bottles.name: Five bottles
bottles.text: Water: clear spring water. Forest Essence: green, smells of pine. Sun Dust: golden powder, warm to the touch. Moon Dust: silver powder, cool to the touch. Dragon Ash: black powder that smells of smoke.
bottles.purpose: Ingredients for the Elixir of Memory.

crown.name: Guardian's Crown
crown.text: The Guardian's Crown, given to those who were brave together.
crown.purpose: Proof that the curse is broken.

sigil_moon.name: Moon Sigil
sigil_moon.text: The Moon Sigil. Seal of the Art of the Moon.

sigil_time.name: Time Sigil
sigil_time.text: The Time Sigil. Seal of the Art of Time.

sigil_knowledge.name: Knowledge Sigil
sigil_knowledge.text: The Knowledge Sigil. Seal of the Art of Knowledge.

sigil_balance.name: Balance Sigil
sigil_balance.text: The Balance Sigil. Seal of the Art of Balance.

sigil_star.name: Star Sigil
sigil_star.text: The Star Sigil. Seal of the Art of Stars.

sigil_light.name: Light Sigil
sigil_light.text: The Light Sigil. Seal of the Art of Light.

sigil_seventh.name: Seventh Seal
sigil_seventh.text: The seventh seal, shown by the Guardian.

riddle_choice.title: The inscription
riddle_choice.prompt: I have teeth, but I cannot bite. I open doors, but I have no hands. What am I?

dial_room2.title: The dial lock
dial_room2.prompt: Turn the four wheels, then press Open.

letters.title: The reading desk
letters.prompt: Take the first letter of each sentence, in book order.
letters.symbolPrompt: A symbol lock. Which symbol matches the word?

cauldron.title: The cauldron
cauldron.prompt: Add the ingredients in the order of the recipe.

dial_room5.title: The celestial wheel
dial_room5.prompt: Turn the four rings, then press Open.

light_table.title: The Light Table
light_table.prompt: Tap a mirror to turn it. Guide the beam to the crystal.

seal_slots.title: The great door
seal_slots.prompt: Pick a seal, then tap its slot.

riddle_final.title: The Guardian's question
riddle_final.prompt: The moon remembers. Time reveals. Knowledge guides. Balance sustains. The stars point the way. Light defeats the shadow. But what gives magic its purpose?

rooms.title: The Forgotten Entrance
rooms.lesson: Lesson 1: the Art of the Moon
